review.notes: Full review of the repaired head. Previous review had no finding; its one format note is carried. Record comparison with the README at the merge base: every layer id and item kept with its statement. Seeded sample of 15 sections: 12 verified against Lojasiewicz1964, Forstneric2018, DemaillyAgbook and WhitneyBruhat1959 (39 locators); sections 3.2 and 4.2 rest on Hormander1990 and Grauert1958, cited by locator alone and not readable; section 0.2 has no locator. 63 Tau Ceti declarations behind the In Tau Ceti lines opened at the pin and compared with the items; all 203 Tau Ceti names located. Cross-roadmap citations resolved on main for all seven suppliers. Dependency check: 0 problems, no UPWARD or CYCLE. Automatic checks all pass. Suggested.lean elaborates with eight sorry warnings and no error; one-tactic probe closes none of the eight theorems. Small corrections: two sentences of the description (Suggested.lean said unchanged; main's L2 hypothesis said omitted) and one word in a Check of 2.0b. Two source issues recorded for Lojasiewicz1964.
